text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D at a gain felt satisfying, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should weigh each stock’s future prospects.","My account value fell after the first sale and again after the second, then recovered somewhat, reminding me that short-term price moves are unpredictable and my trades do not control them.","I check and trade frequently, but I should avoid reacting to monthly fluctuations and make decisions based on a consistent plan rather than the pleasure of locking in gains or the pain of losses."]}
